description: Queries a Cerner FHIR server using SMART backend services JWT-bearer authentication and pushes each returned resource downstream as JSON.

config.label: Interval
config.description: How often, in milliseconds, the runtime invokes the polling script.

config.label: Base URL
config.description: The base Cerner FHIR endpoint for your tenant. This must match the tenant used when issuing OAuth tokens and should not include resource paths like '/Patient'. A trailing slash is added if missing.

config.label: Client ID
config.description: The OAuth client identifier assigned to your Cerner application on CernerCentral.

config.label: Private Key Path
config.description: Absolute path to the PEM-encoded RSA private key whose public key is registered in the JWKS on the CernerCentral System Account. Read at authentication time and never copied into the node config.

config.label: Key ID
config.description: The kid (Key ID) identifying which public key in your JWKS Cerner should use to verify the JWT signature. Placed in the JWT header.

config.label: Scopes
config.description: SMART on FHIR OAuth scopes requested when obtaining an access token, space-separated. Cerner requires scopes on the token request.

config.label: Resource Type
config.description: FHIR resource type to search on each poll, for example Patient, Encounter or Observation.

config.label: Search Query
config.description: Search parameters as a URL query string, for example family=Smith&birthdate=1970-01-01. Leave empty to search without filters.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, FHIR requests are simulated and no data leaves the runtime, which is useful while wiring up a workflow. Authentication is always performed live so credential problems surface immediately.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Whether to verify the Cerner server's TLS certificate. Leave on outside of local testing against a proxy.
